snippet.title: Escape from Duckov - Official Release Date Trailer
snippet.description: Check out the Release Date Trailer for Escape from Duckov, the top-down looter shooter developed by Team Soda. Players will take up arms to take on enemies that have invaded the shelter. Extract with powerful loot in Escape from Duckov, launching on October 16 for macOS and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).
